title: Two attempts, one key
description: Send two concurrent attempts with the same key k7 and compare an atomic claim, where both paths meet at one socket, with a check followed by a separate write.
initialCaption: Two concurrent attempts carry key k7 for release v1. Send both and see whether their paths meet at one claim.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: Two attempts for the same release carry key k7 at the same moment. When the claim of k7 and the ticket write happen in one transaction, both paths meet at a single claim: one ticket, #47, is written and both runners receive it. When each attempt checks for k7 and writes separately, both checks find nothing and two tickets, #47 and #48, are created.
